# Monocypher

A small cryptography library, used for ChaCha20-Poly1305 by AirPlay output.

`monocypher.c` and `monocypher.h` are copied unmodified from Monocypher 4.0.2:
https://monocypher.org/download/monocypher-4.0.2.tar.gz
(SHA-256 38d07179738c0c90677dba3ceb7a7b8496bcfea758ba1a53e803fed30ae0879c)

`LICENCE.md` is Monocypher's, from the same release: BSD-2-Clause or CC0.
